title: Delta Force controls on PlayStation / PS5
note: The official PlayStation page confirms basic controller remapping and control reminders, but no stable default button table was available from a verifiable source during this update. Capture the installed studio build's default layout before publishing a button map.
text:
Delta Force บน PlayStation / PS5 มีข้อมูลปุ่มควบคุม 0 รายการ
หมายเหตุ: The official PlayStation page confirms basic controller remapping and control reminders, but no stable default button table was available from a verifiable source during this update. Capture the installed studio build's default layout before publishing a button map.
